title: Trapped in a Dating Sim 2 Anime's New Video Reveals Theme Songs
content: Kadokawa started streaming the second promotional video for the second television anime season based on Yomu Mishima 's Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs ( Otome Game Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai Desu ) light novel series on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: MobSeka: Trapped in a Dating Sim Season 2 New Trailer and Theme Songs Revealed
content: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome is Tough for Mobs ( MobSeka ) Season 2 revealed the second trailer ahead of its July 8 premiere date. Studio ENGI is returning to animate, with Kazura Miura back as the sole director (he co-directed Season 1 with Shinichi Fukumoto).
author: Anime Corner

title: Just Like Mona Lisa Anime by Studio SHAFT Officially Announced
content: Tsumuji Yoshimura’s Just Like Mona Lisa ( Seibetsu “Mona Lisa” no Kimi e ) is officially receiving a TV anime adaptation, with animation by studio SHAFT. The announcement was accompanied by a teaser visual and a special commemorative illustration from Yoshimura.
author: Anime Corner

title: Sazae-san Chief Director Hiromitsu Morita Dies
content: Animator and director Hiromitsu Morita died on June 4. Animation studio Eiken announced of his death on Monday. The announcement did not mention the cause of his death, and it noted that Morita had voluntarily retired in March 2024.
author: ANN

title: Shaft Produces 'Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e.' TV Anime Adaptation
content: Production company CyberAgent opened an official website for a television anime adaptation Tsumuji Yoshimura 's Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e. ( Just Like Mona Lisa ) manga on Wednesday. The website revealed a teaser visual (pictured) and Shaft as the animation studio.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Just Like Mona Lisa Manga Gets TV Anime by SHAFT
content: CyberAgent announced on Wednesday that it is producing a television anime adaptation of Tsumuji Yoshimura 's Just Like Mona Lisa ( Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e. ) manga. SHAFT is animating the television anime. Yoshimura drew the below illustration to celebrate the anime's announcement.
author: ANN

title: Yuruyuru Zukan Children's Books Get TV Anime in October
content: Publisher Gakken announced on Wednesday that its Yuruyuru Zukan (Gentle Picture Book) children's book series will have a television anime that will premiere within the Sunday program Animori! on TV Tokyo and 5 affiliated channels in October.
author: ANN

title: Black Clover Confirms a Massive Change in Season 2 Ahead of Premiere
content: After 11 years of serialization, Yuki Tabata’s hit action-fantasy manga, Black Clover , has finally reached its conclusion. The manga entered its Final Arc in 2022 before transitioning to Shueisha’s Jump GIGA magazine on a quarterly schedule due to Tabata’s health issues.
author: ComicBook
